nativeValidation.setup: Run the first four commands from the exact revision in a disposable local checkout on delino-win-1. Run the last command separately on Windows with SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege and repeat commands 1 through 3 first. Do not treat a skipped link test as acceptance.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'a4c4aa11105b27edb4596957e8f25da353724e91') { throw 'Unexpected validation revision' }

go test -v '-count=1' '-run=^Test(RepairTarDirectoryLinksWithoutSymlinkPrivilege|ReadTarRejectsEscapes|ExportImportRoundTrip|ImportStopsWhenTheContextIsDone)$' ./internal/fsutil ./cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/snapxfer 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath '.t3-tmp/windows-snapshot-unprivileged.log'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Non-elevated Windows tests failed' }

go test -v '-count=1' '-run=^Test(ReadTarDirectoryLinksInEitherOrder|ReadTarRejectsChainedSymlinkEscape|ReadTarRejectsLinkThatLaterBecomesChained|ExportImportRoundTripWithForwardDirectoryLinks|ImportRejectsSymlinkEscape)$' ./internal/fsutil ./cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/snapxfer 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath '.t3-tmp/windows-snapshot-symlinks.log'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or (Select-String -Path '.t3-tmp/windows-snapshot-symlinks.log' -SimpleMatch '--- SKIP:')) { throw 'Windows symbolic-link acceptance failed or skipped' }
expectedResults: The non-elevated command exits zero. The repair fixture uses actual Windows filesystem attributes. It recreates the file-form stand-in, skips the directory-form stand-in, preserves the original on cancellation, rejects creation failure, and rejects a replacement that still lacks the directory attribute. The archive name and target checks, ordinary round trip, and canceled import also pass.

The symlink command exits zero with no skips. Direct and chained reads through real, relative directory symlinks return the original data after extraction and publication. Both tar orders pass. Regular-file and dangling links retain their expected behavior. The confinement fixtures preserve the extraction boundary.
